prompt: Explain why solar energy is becoming cheaper than coal in plain language.

script.title: The Solar Switch
script.hook: Coal used to be king, but the sun just won the price war.

sections.title: The Economics
sections.content: Solar tech is a manufactured product, not a fuel we have to dig up. As we make more panels, the price crashes, just like flat-screen TVs.

sections.title: The Reality
sections.content: In many places, building new solar farms is now officially cheaper than keeping old coal plants running.

sections.title: The Takeaway
sections.content: Clean energy is no longer just 'nice to have'—it’s the smartest financial choice.

script.cta: Follow for more plain English science.

script.audioMood: Inspirational, driving synth beat with a sense of clarity
